newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends down on CBOT soycomplex, locals.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends down on CBOT soycomplex, locals.

text.p: WCE canola ended lower, pulled down by a slide in CBOT soycomplex futures and local selling.
"Locals sold on the weakness in Chicago, a trader said. "There were late November hedges, Japan bought July at the close. Commercials bought scale down."

July WCE futures crush margin fell to +3.39 Tuesday from +6.57 Monday. About 325 July-Nov spread at $33, 450 July-Aug at even money. Volume was 3,310 lots, or 66,200 tonnes, with 200 hedges. Japan bought 3-5,000 tonnes canola overnight, sources said.
July canola lost $1.90 to $405.90 and November fell $1.40 to $372.90. July flax rose $1.90 to $332.90 as RBC-DS bought, traders said.

July western barley rose $0.40 to $133.80 on commercials and October climbed $0.50 to $135 with gains limited by good growing conditions. July-Oct was offered at $1 and bid at $1.50. Volume was 450 lots.
United Grain Growers bought 15 July wheat up $0.20 at $160, traders said, and Alberta Wheat Pool sold 20 July-Oct at $1.20. Volume was 180 lots.
UGG sold July feed peas down the US$5 limit to a new contract low of US$187, sources said.
RBC-DS sold 75 October feed peas down US$1.90 to US$186.10 to commercials and commission houses, sources said. A commercial sold December down US$4.20 to US$185, traders said.
RBC-DS bought 20 October oats up US$2 to US$120 from PCTS.
(All prices in Canadian dollars/tonne except oats, peas).
